name: vsb_CancelCheckListApproval
description: Cancels an in-flight checklist-item approval and resets the Project Checklist row, IN ONE TRANSACTION. WHY IT EXISTS: the flow it replaces performs three synchronous writes with no waits, and the app has no way to make three writes atomic — dataClient.batch() bounds concurrency over individual writes, it is not a transactional $batch changeset. So a mid-sequence failure can leave an approval cancelled with the checklist row un-reset: vsb_approvalcheckliststate still shows the approval running, vsb_flowrunid still points at a dead run, and the row action still offers 'Cancel Approval'. The flow already signals that risk in its own contract — it answers {success:false} when its scope fails — and the canvas read `.success` off the result AND DID NOTHING WITH A FALSE, which is how the inconsistent state became invisible. This API is the fix: the three writes are the platform transaction, so there is no partial outcome to report.
notes: The three writes ARE the only thing that changes the checklist state, which is why a reported failure must leave the row exactly as it was. That sentence is already in rules.ts above checklistCancelSucceeded(); this API is what makes it true rather than aspirational.

checklistCancelSucceeded() treats anything that is not an explicit false as success (UT-CHKLST-034 pins `{}` and `null` as true). That is safe against the typed wrapper's mock, and UNSAFE against this API's `Success` property, which the function does not currently read. Widen it when wiring up.

requestParameters.description: vsb_projectchecklist row id. The only argument the app passes today: cancelCheckListApproval({checklistId}) in src/flows/flowClient.ts, called from useCancelChecklistApproval with args.checklistId. The plugin reads the project, cluster state, owning business unit, vsb_flowrunid and vsb_flowapprovalid from the row.

Optional, unlike the gate cancellation. The checklist branch's audit row is written by checklistNoteWrite() into vsb_projectchecklisttrackingnote, and useCancelChecklistApproval makes NO local writes at all — it calls the API and invalidates. Where a comment is supplied the plugin writes the note inside the same transaction; where it is not, the reset happens alone, which is the behaviour the flow had.

responseProperties.description: The flow's own {success:boolean} contract, preserved so the call site does not have to change shape. It is now nearly always true: a failure faults and rolls back instead of reporting.
Empty on success; otherwise CHECKLIST_CANCEL_FAILED verbatim — "The approval could not be cancelled. Nothing was changed." (UT-CHKLST-034).
The vsb_projectchecklisttrackingnote row, or empty when no Comment was supplied.

writes: UPDATE vsb_projectchecklist(ChecklistId): vsb_approvalcheckliststate reset, vsb_approvalstepstatecode reset, vsb_flowrunid = null — CHECKLIST_COL in src/features/pm/checklist/rules.ts
CANCEL the msdyn_flow_approval identified by the row's vsb_flowapprovalid / vsb_flowrunid
CREATE vsb_projectchecklisttrackingnote when Comment is supplied: vsb_notetype = 952850001 (Checklist Item), vsb_ProjectChecklist = the row, owningbusinessunit = the project's — checklistNoteWrite()
